tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gur zhal gnyis kyi rten gyi gzungs dang zhal bzhi rtag gtor gyi gzungs tshar chen gyi phyag bris la ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa'i yi ge bzhugs// swasti/ nag po chen po'i rten gyi gzungs/ /tshar chen gyi phyag bris ma la ji ltar yod pa'i tshul yi ger bkod pa la/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa lte ba/ phyi rol du mu khyud nyis rim dang bcas pa'i lte ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ de'i yig mgo phyogs nas phyi nas rim pa bzhin nang la g.yas bskor gyi oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa lags pas gnas khang 'di nyid du rten 'di nyid la brtan par bzhugs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ bla ma'i sku tshe srings/ bye brag tu yangs pa'i phyogs 'dir bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / rje btsun rdo ring kun spangs pa chen po/ bdag blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dpon slob rnams kyi bstan pa dri ma med pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par mdzod/ khyad par du yang mang mkhar phu'i dgon pa thub bstan dge 'phel zhes bya ba 'di nyid kyi mi nor gtsug lag khang sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchod rdzas dang bcas pa 'di'i char gtogs pa'i grwa pa/ btsun ma/ dgon gnas/ zhing gzhis/ mkhar khang longs spyod/ nor rdzas rta phyugs ra lug sa phyogs 'di'i ri klung chu la gnas pa'i ri dwags la sogs pa'i srog chags/ dad cing gus pa'i bkur bsti zhabs rtog byed pa'i sbyin bdag mi nor longs spyod yul gzhis dang bcas pa thams cad khyod la bcol zhing gnyer du gtad pa yin pas bcol ba yong bar gyis/

gtad pa thub par gyis/ nyin gsum gyi bya ra mdzod/ mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzod/ 'di na gnas pa thams cad bkra shis dang dge legs dang ldan pa dang / tshe dang bsod nams dbang phyug mnga' thang rgyas pa dang / lung rtogs kyi yon tan thos bsam bsgom pa'i 'phrin las thams cad dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par mdzad du gsol/ dpal dang 'byor pa snyan pa'i grags pa phun sum tshogs par mdzad du gsol/ 'di dag la gnod cing 'tshe ba/ brnyas shing dmod pa log par blta ba/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad lo dang zla bar ma bzhag pa zhag dang za ma'i dus nyid du drag po'i las kyis tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ de ltar ma byas na ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen po la sogs pa rtsa rgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las 'das par 'gyur bas dam tshig rjes su dran par mdzod cig sa ma ya zhes dang / rtsibs bcu la/ oṃ mahā kā la hūm̐ phaṭ/ rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas sgrub pa po bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod ces pa yig star bzhi re la shongs pa rtsibs bcu la re re dang / rtsibs bar bcu la shrī mahā kā la ye mā ma man tra sarbā sid+dhiṃ ku ru hūm̐/ zhes pa yig star gnyis la shong pa re re dang / phyi'i mu khyud dang po la lte ba'i hūm̐ gi yig mgo phyogs nas/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ a/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ zhes pa dbyangs gsal spel ba tshar gsum gyi rjes la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas bdag cag dpon slob mi nor dgon gnas dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod ces pa g.yas bskor du bris la 'khor yug tu bskor/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la/ ye dharmā he tu pra bhā bā he tun+te ṣan+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data te ṣañca yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dā+e mahā shra ma ṇaḥzhes pa tshar lnga'i rjes la/

dpal rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas bdag cag dpon slob mi nor dgon gnas dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod ces pa 'khor yug g.yas bskor du skor ba mdzad 'dug cing // ༈ //yang zhal bzhi pa'i rten gyi gzungs kyi 'khor lo tshar chen gyi phyag bris ma la ji ltar yod tshul bkod pa la/ 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa lte ba mu khyud gcig dang bcas pa lte bar yi ge hūm̐ gi mtshan pa'i zhabs kyu'i phyogs nas phyi nas nang bskor la rim pa bzhin g.yas skor du/ oṃ mahā kā la kā la ka rā ka ra la mī ta o ṭha/ stobs 'phrog rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa zhing skyong zil ldan dbang phyug bram ze'i gzugs can dpa' bo/ /yum chen g.yung mo nag mo/ /las mdzad gtum mo ljang khu/ dmar nag srin mo chen mo/ ser nag siṅga li ma/ 'khor gyi zhing skyong 'bum rdo/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ srog gi dgu bdud nag po/ las kyi shan pa nyer gcig snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu/ cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas gnas khang 'di nyid du rten 'di nyid la brtan par bzhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ bla ma'i sku tshe srings/ bye brag tu yangs pa'i phyogs 'dir bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / rje btsun rdo ring kun spangs pa chen po/ bdag blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dpon slob rnams kyi bstan pa dri ma med pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par mdzod/ /khyad par du yang che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di nyid kyi mi nor gtsug lag khang sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchod rdzas dang bcas pa 'di'i char gtogs pa'i grwa pa btsun ma dgon gnas zhing gzhis mkhar khang longs spyod nor rdzas rta phyugs ra lug sa phyogs 'di'i ri klung chu la gnas pa'i ri dwags la sogs srog chags/

dad cing gus pas bkur bsti zhabs tog byed pa'i sbyin bdag mi nor longs spyod yul gzhis dang bcas pa thams cad bcol zhing gnyer du gtad pa yin pas bcol ba yong bar gyis/ gtad pa thub par gyis/ nyin gsum gyi bya ra mdzod/ /mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzod/ /'di na/ 'di na gnas pa thams cad du bkra shis dge legs dang ldan pa dang / tshe dang bsod nams dbang phyug mnga' thang rgyas pa dang / lung rtogs kyi yon tan thos bsam bsgom pa'i 'phrin las thams cad dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par mdzad du gsol/ dpal dang 'byor ma snyan grags phun sum tshogs par mdzad du gsol/ 'di dag la gnod cing 'tshe ba brnyas shing dmod pa/ log par lta ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad lo dang zla bar ma bzhag par zhag dang za ma'i dus de nyid du drag po'i las kyi tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ de ltar ma byas na ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen po la sogs pa rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las 'das par 'gyur bas dam tshig rjes su dran par mdzod cig sa ma ya zhes dang / nang gi mu khyud la gong bzhin lte ba'i hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu phyogs nas phyi nas nang la rim pa bzhin g.yas skor du/ lam+ba ka be ka lam+ba ka ba le/ ra bi ghaṇ+ṭa/ ru ṭa mā la bi hu re/ ts+tshe da ha ka le/ ha le na ha le/ pim+bi dzā le/ bā le ghan+di dha ri yaṃ ma eṃ/ da hi na karti ka ka ro ṭi/ bi bhi ṣa ṇa dha eṃ/ bā me shu la pa ṇi/ ha ra do ra na ra sī ra mā la/ pā tā le k+ṣiṃ kā ra ka la/ mahā po ṭa le/ mahā kā la shri ka bī la ki bi la siṃ k+ṣe ta pā la/ hā hā kā re/ hūm̐ hūm̐ kā re/ purba bha ṣa bhi uṃ/ dzau dzan+ti dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas bdag blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dpon slob mi nor cha gtogs dang bcas pa byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung ba dang skyabs dang sba bar mdzad du gsol/

'di dag la gnod cing 'tshe ba log par 'dren pa'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub rnams zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar ma 'tshal na drag po mngon spyod kyi las kyis ma thogs myur ba nyid du bsgral ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ sa ma ya/ sid+dhiṃ ku ru hūm̐ zhes pa gong bzhin phyi nas rim pa ltar nang la bskor ba'i yig 'phreng gnyis kyi 'khor yug du khang ba dang / lte ba'i hūm̐ gis zhabs kyu phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs la/ oṃ u tsaṭ+ṭa tsaṭ+ṭe swā hūm̐/ rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas che ge mo'i mi nor dgon gnas longs spyod dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod ces dang / rtsibs gnyis pa la/ sa i yaṃ/ rten 'di la zhes pa nas srung ma mdzod ces pa'i bar gong bzhin/ rtsibs gsum par sa ka ra la hi yaṃ/ rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas zhes pa nas srung ma mdzod ces pa'i bar gong bzhin/ rtsibs bzhi par sa hu baṃ/ rten 'di la brtan par zhes sogs nas srung ma mdzod ces pa'i bar gong bzhin/ rtsibs lnga par gri ta kī li kī la ya/ rten 'di la zhes pa nas srung ma mdzod ces pa'i bar gong bzhin/ rtsibs drug par bi bhi ṣa na pa ta ya na maḥ rten 'di la zhes pa nas srung ma mdzod ces pa'i bar gong bzhin ste yig phreng bzhi re la shong pa dang / rtsibs bar rnams la lte ba'i hūm̐ yig gi g.yon phyogs kyi rtsibs bar la/ oṃ u tsaṭ+ṭe swa hūm̐/ rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas che ge mo'i mi nor dgon gnas longs spyod dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod ces dang / gnyis pa la/ sa i yaṃ/ rten 'di la zhes pa nas srung ma mdzod ces pa'i bar gong bzhin/ gsum par sa ka ra la hi yaṃ/ rten 'di la zhes pa nas srung ma mdzod ces pa'i bar gong bzhin/ bzhi par sa hu baṃ rten 'di la zhes pa nas srung ma mdzod ces pa'i bar gong bzhin/

lnga par gri ta kī li kī la ya/ rten 'di la zhes pa nas srung ma mdzod ces pa'i bar gong bzhin/ drug par bi bhi ṣa na pa ta ya na maḥ rten 'di la zhes pa nas srung ma mdzod ces pa'i bar gong bzhin yig ltar gsum re'i khengs pa dang / phyi'i mu khyud la lte ba'i hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu phyogs nas/ oṃ mahā kā la kā la kaṭ+ṭa ka ra la/ lam+bi ta o ṭha/ lam+ba ka be ka lam+bha ka ba le/ ra bi ghaṇ+ṭa/ ru ṭa mā le bi hu re/ ts+tshe da ha ka le/ ha le na ha le/ pam+bi dzā li/ bā me ghun+di dha ri yaṃ ma eṃ/ da hi na karti ka kā ro ṭi/ bi bha ṣa na dha eṃ/ bā me shu la pa ṇi/ ha ro do ra/ na ra sī ra mā la/ pā tā le k+ṣiṃ kā ra kā la/ mahā po ṭa le/ mahā kā la shrī ka bi la siṃ k+ṣe ṭa pā la/ hā hā kā re/ hūm̐ hūm̐ kā re/ purba bha ṣa bha uṃ/ dzau dzan+ti/ mā ma sa pa ri wā ra s+ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ oṃ ḍom+bi nī mā ma sa pa ri wā ra s+ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ oṃ tsan+ya li mā ma sa pa ri wā ra s+ya ra k+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥ oṃ rak+ṣa sī mā ma sa pa ri wā ra s+ya rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣaḥ oṃ siṅga lī mā ma sa pa ri wā ra s+ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ oṃ mahā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ mā ma sa pa ri wa ra rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣa/ mā ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu ku ru ho zhes pa'i bar gyi g.yas bskor du khrig khang pa mdzad 'dug yang zhal bzhi pa'i rtag gtor gyi gzungs 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa phyi rol du mu khyud gcig dang / lte bar mu khyud gcig gi nang du ling tshe gru bzhi bco lnga yod pa'i steng zur gyi ling tshe dang po la/ oṃ u tsaṭ+ṭa tsaṭ+ṭi swa hūm̐/ rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa gtor ma 'di la brtan par bzhugs shing gzhol la bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa srung skyabs sba ba'i 'phrin las mdzad pa dang bcol ba'i las thams cad grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang / ling tshe gnyis pa la oṃ u tsaṭ+ṭa tseṭ+ṭa swa hūm̐/

rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo chen mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa gtor ma 'di la brtan par bzhugs la bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa mi nor dgon gnas zhing gzhis mkhar khang longs spyod dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod ces dang / ling tshe gsum pa/ bzhi pa/ lnga pa rnams la yang gong ling tshe gnyis pa bzhin gyi sngags dang 'phrin bcol dang / de'i 'og ling tshe lnga'i dang po la/ oṃ ḍom+bi ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rak+kha sī hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ siṅga liṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yum chen sring mo chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa gtor ma 'di la brtan par bzhugs shing bzhes la bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa mi nor zhing gzhis mkhar khang longs spyod dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod ces dang / de bzhin ling tshe gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa/ lnga pa rnams la yang bri/ de'i 'og ling tshe lnga pa'i dang po la sa i yaṃ rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo chen mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa gtor ma 'di la brtan par bzhugs shing bzhes la bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa mi nor dgon gnas zhing gzhis mkhar khang longs spyod dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod/ /ces dang / ling tshe gnyis par sa ka ra la hi yaṃ/ rdo rje nag po chen po nas srung ma mdzod zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin dang / ling tshe gsum pa la sa hu baṃ/ rdo rje nag po chen po nas srung ma mdzod ces pa'i bar gong bzhin/ ling tshe bzhi pa la gri ta kī li kī la ya/ rdo rje nag po chen po nas srung ma mdzod ces pa'i bar gong bzhin/ ling tshe lnga par/ bi bhi ṣa na pā ta ya na maḥ rdo rje nag po chen po nas srung ma mdzod cig ces pa'i bar gong bzhin dang / nang gi mu khyud la/ ling tshe bco lnga'i yi ge'i zhabs phyogs nas/ oṃ ḍom+bi ni hūm̐ yum chen g.yung mo nag mo 'khor dang bcas pa gtor ma 'di la brtan par bzhugs zhing bzhes la bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod/

/de'i 'gab la 'thud nas/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ las mdzad gtum mo ljang khu 'khor dang bcas pa gtor ma 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas bzhes la bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod/ oṃ siṅga lī hūm̐ phaṭ/ ser nag siṅga li ma 'khor dang bcas pa gtor ma 'di la brtan par bzhugs shing bzhes la bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod/ /oṃ rak+kha si hūm̐ phaṭ/ dmar nag srin mo chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa gtor ma 'di la brtan par bzhugs shing bzhes la bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod ces pa'i bar lte ba'i mu khyud 'khor yug du khrig khang ba mdzad 'dug cing / lte ba'i ling tshe bco lnga'i yig mgo phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs dang po la/ sa hūm̐ baṃ gtor ma 'di la brtan par bzhugs zhing bzhes la bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa mi nor dgon gnas zhing gzhis mkhar khang longs spyod dang bcas pa'i srung ma dang bcol ba'i las thams cad grub par mdzad du gsol/ yang g.yas bskor gyi rtsibs gnyis pa la gri te kī li kī la ya gtor ma 'di la zhes pa nas grub par mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i bar gong ltar dang / gsum pa la bi bhi ṣa na pa ta ya na maḥ gtor ma nas mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin/ bzhi pa la oṃ u tsuṭ+ṭa tsiṭ+ṭa swā hūm̐/ gtor ma nas mdzad du gsol ces pa'i bar gong bzhin/ lnga pa la sa li yaṃ/ gtor ma nas mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin/ drug pa la sā ka ra la hi yaṃ/ gtor ma nas mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin dang / rtsibs bar rnams la lte ba'i ling tshe'i yig mgo phyogs nas 'khor lo'i rtsibs dang po dang / gnyis pa'i bar la gri ta kī li kī la ya/ gtor ma 'di la brtan par bzhugs shing bzhes la bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa mi nor dgon gnas zhing gzhis mkhar khang longs spyod dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzod ces dang / gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i bar la bi bhi ṣa na pā ta ya na maḥ

gtor ma nas srung ma mdzod ces pa'i bar gong bzhin/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i bar la oṃ u tsaṭ+ṭa tsiṭ+ṭa swā hūm̐/ gtor ma nas srung ma mdzad do zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin/ bzhi pa dang lnga pa'i bar bar la sa i yaṃ/ gtor ma nas srung ma mdzod ces pa'i bar gong bzhin/ lnga pa dang drug pa'i bar la sa kā ra la hi yaṃ/ gtor ma nas srung ma mdzod ces pa'i bar gong bzhin/ drug pa dang dang po'i bar la sa hu baṃ/ gtor ma nas srung ma mdzod ces pa'i bar gong bzhin ste/ lte ba'i ling tshe 'khor lo'i rtsibs bar rnams kyi yig 'phreng la ling tshe rnams la yig phreng bcu ma re dang / rtsibs bar rnams la yig 'phreng bzhi ma re mdzad 'dug cing / phyi'i mu khyud la lte ba'i ling tshe rnams kyi yi ge'i 'jug phyogs nas/ oṃ mahā kā la kā la/ bi kaṭ+ṭa kā ra la/ lam+bi ta o ṭha/ lam+ba kā be ka lam+ba ka ba le/ ra bi ghaṇ+ḍa/ ru ṭa mā ma le hu re/ ts+tshe da ha ka le/ ha le na ha leṃ/ pim+bi dzā li/ bā me ghun+di ri yaṃ ma eṃ/ da hi na karti ka kā ro ṭi/ bi bhi ṣa na dha eṃ/ bā me shu la pā ni/ ha ra do ra/ na ra sī rā mā la/ pā tā le k+ṣiṃ kā ra kā la/ mahā po tra leṃ/ mahā kā la shrī ka bi la siṃ k+ṣe ṭa pā la/ hā hā kā re/ hūm̐ hūm̐ kā re/ surba bha ṣa bhi uṃ/ dzau dzan+ti/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa/ yum chen sring mo chen mo bzhi 'khor dregs pa pho mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams dam rdzas kyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di la brtan par bzhugs la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung / dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ bla ma dam pa'i 'phrin las sgrubs/ khyad par du yang sgrub pa po bdag gi srung ma mdzod/ /mi nor dgon gnas yul 'khor longs spyod dang bcas pa'i gnyer mdzod/ byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal skyen sel/ mthun rkyen bsgrub/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bde blag tu stsal du gsol/

zhes pa'i bar gyi yi ge rnams kyi mu khyud khrig khengs par mdzad 'dug go /de ltar gur gyi mgon po dang zhal bzhi pa'i rten dang / gtor ma'i gzungs 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i bri tshul 'di ni rje tshar chen gyis phyag bris ma las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi bkod pa 'dis 'phral dang yun dge legs su gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ gur zhal gnyis kyi rten gyi gzungs dang zhal bzhi'i rtag gtor gyi gzungs / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
